2292-7084-8293.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Cleveland Booker triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

2921-5170-6132-8292.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Massacre Girl triggers, dealing 1 damage to target opponent and causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Massacre Girl trigger.
Resolve the Massacre Girl trigger, dealing 1 damage to target opponent and causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio
Repeat.

3941-4331-4993-8176.description:
Activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Coveted Jewel.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {0} due to Geist of Saint Thalia.
Repeat.

4419-4694-5315-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
4419-4694-5315-7306.description:
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Renata.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 1.

5531-5694-6763-7874-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
5531-5694-6763-7874-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, The Immortal Weapons and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, The Immortal Weapons and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Resolve the The Immortal Weapons trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Repeat.
5531-5694-6763-7874-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink The Immortal Weapons and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

2893-3875-6763-7906.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
When the basic land enters, Tireless Provisioner and Thranduil's Company trigger.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token
Resolve the Thranduil's Company trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Repeat.

2457-2757-4365.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens due to Mondrak.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a creature token, untapping a basic Forest.
Activate the Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 one additional time.
Repeat from step 1.

3132-3259-4359.easyPrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
3132-3259-4359.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3132-3259-4359.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Bladewing, triggering Breath of Fury and Bladewing.
Resolve the Bladewing trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

2034-3605-4812-5987.description:
Cast Animate Dead by paying {1}{B}.
When Animate Dead enters, it trigger, returning Angel of Indemnity from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Animate Dead to it.
When Angel of Indemnity enters, it triggers, targeting Dance of the Dead.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Angel of Indemnity.
Resolve the Angel of Indemnity trigger, returning Dance of the Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dance of the Dead enters, it trigger, returning Angel of Indemnity from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Dance of the Dead to it.
When Angel of Indemnity enters, it triggers, targeting Animate Dead.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Angel of Indemnity.
Resolve the Angel of Indemnity trigger, returning Animate Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

222-4871-5147--73.easyPrerequisites:
The persist or undying creature doesn't have a -1/-1 or +1/+1 counter on it, respective to its ability.
You control a Saproling.
222-4871-5147--73.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment twice by sacrificing the persist or undying creature and Slimefoot and Squee.
When Slimefoot and Squee and the other creature die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice and the other creature's persist or undying ability triggers.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the persist or undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with either a -1/-1 or +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the undying or persist creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{R}{G}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling.
When the Saproling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee ability, returning it and the persist or undying creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1558-2638-3147-4231-6753.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-2638-3147-4231-6753.description:
Play Azorius Chancery.
When Azorius Chancery enters, it and Tireless Tracker trigger
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Exalted Sunborn.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

240-5147-5470-7175.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target
Repeat from step 2.

465-3742-4251-4875-7175.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

628-2438-7199.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Slumbering Walker.
When Slumbering Walker dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability
Repeat.

977-1020-1766-2866-4659.description:
Announce the activation of Chromatic Star's second ability.
During this activation, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing Thran Dynamo and Myr Retriever, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Continue activating and resolving the Chromatic Star ability, paying {1}, tapping it, and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Scrap Trawler triggers twice, Myr Retriever triggers once, and Chromatic Star triggers once.
Resolve the Chromatic Star trigger, drawing a card.
Resolve the Scrap Trawler trigger from Myr Retriever, returning Chromatic Star from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Scrap Trawler trigger from Thran Dynamo, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Myr Retriever trigger, returning Thran Dynamo from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Chromatic Star by paying {1}.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {2}.
Cast Thran Dynamo by paying {4}.
Repeat.
977-1020-1766-2866-4659.notes: This combo works by taking advantage of the fact that you can activate mana abilities during the declared activation of an activated ability. This allows you to delay putting the Trawler and Retriever triggers on the stack (and selecting their targets) until all permanents you need to target are in the graveyard. For more information, please see rules 605.3, 602.2b, and 601.2g.

1651-1770-1863-3875-6756.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1651-1770-1863-3875-6756.notablePrerequisites: Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1651-1770-1863-3875-6756.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Tireless Provisioner triggers twice due to Elesh Norn, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

2438-4681-6981.description:
Cast Perigee Beckoner for its warp cost by paying {1}{B}.
When Perigee Beckoner enters, it triggers, targeting Karmic Guide.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Perigee Beckoner.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Perigee Beckoner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Perigee Beckoner enters, it triggers, targeting Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.

338-4490.notablePrerequisites:
Shalai and Hallar has lifelink.
You have a way to gain life.
338-4490.description:
Gain life by any method.
Shalai and Hallar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Shalai and Hallar triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent and causing you to gain at least 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

4812-5145-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars.
When Archon of Falling Stars dies, it triggers, returning Animate Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Animate Dead enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Archon of Falling Stars from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Animate Dead to it.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Repeat.

1636-5256-6773.easyPrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard
1636-5256-6773.description:
Activate Xu-Ifit by tapping it, returning a creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature returned in step 1.
Repeat.

215-2499-6470.description:
Cast Iridescent Tiger by paying {4}{R}.
When Iridescent Tiger enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Iridescent Tiger from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2092-3525-4720-5516.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls a creature.
Red Death does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Red Death.
2092-3525-4720-5516.description:
Activate Red Death by tapping it, adding {R}, goading a creature an opponent controls and causing that opponent to draw a card.
Activate Stonework Packbeast by paying {1}, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Red Death.
Repeat.

222-527-4359-5231.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {B}{G}{G}.
Activate Thermopod twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1492-4708-5660-5943.notablePrerequisites:
There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
One of the self-sacrificing artifacts must be in your hand, with the other in your graveyard.
1492-4708-5660-5943.description:
Cast the self-sacrificing artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Ms. Bumbleflower triggers, causing an opponent to draw a card, and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning the self-sacrificing artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the self-sacrificing artifact cast in step 1 by sacrificing it, and paying other costs if necessary.
Repeat.

413-2082-3197.easyPrerequisites: Sadistic Glee attached to Herd Baloth.
413-2082-3197.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
413-2082-3197.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies, Sadisitc Glee triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
When the Beast enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

1373-1863-3946.description:
Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, allowing you to choose not to pay the cost and sacrifice it instead.
Repeat.

1020-2866-4659-4947.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Scrap Trawler, adding {C}{C}.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {2}.
Sai triggers, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the Thopter and Myr Retriever, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying {3}.
Sai triggers, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Repeat.

811-4222-4289-5169.notablePrerequisites:
Daring Thief does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Daring Thief.
An opponent controls at least one creature.
811-4222-4289-5169.description:
Activate Daring Thief by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Daring Thief.
Daring Thief triggers, exchanging control of Khârn the Betrayer and any creature.
Khârn the Betrayer triggers, causing the player who lost control of it to draw two cards.
Repeat.

627-1021-2034-5310.description:
Sacrifice Bloodghast to Ashnod's Altar for {C}{C}.
Play Drownyard Temple.
Return Bloodghast to the battlefield.
Use Embodiment of Fury to turn Drownyard Temple into a creature.
Sacrifice Drownyard Temple to Ashnod's Altar.
Repeat.
